items.title: Existence of the surjective map onto the kernel of the first comparison map between the modules attached to consecutive parameters
items.author: Bhimarthi Ravinder
items.work: Demazure Modules, Chari-Venkatesh Modules and Fusion Products
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts the existence of a surjective morphism of current algebra modules from a shift of the module attached to one pair of parameters onto the kernel of the first comparison map, fixed by its value on the cyclic generator (author proposition without an author label, statement at source lines 633-637). The proof (source lines 639-650) checks the five families of defining relations of the source module on the image of the generator: the first family splits into three cases according to the pairing with the highest root and uses the vanishing relations in the next module, the next two families are trivial for the chosen image, and the last two are exactly the statements of the two lemmas labelled g and crucial (proof lines 640-649). The case-by-case verification against the presentations is the content. H2.
